h: A cathedral city on your doorstep
p: Eign Gate is a pedestrianised shopping street running into High Town, the heart of Hereford, so this 18+ MERKUR is right in the busy part of the city. The bus and railway stations are a manageable walk away, and Hereford is compact enough to explore on foot.

Hereford Cathedral is the must-see, home to the Mappa Mundi, the medieval map of the world, and the famous chained library. In High Town, the Old House is a black-and-white Jacobean house turned museum. A stroll down to the River Wye and over the Old Bridge rounds things off nicely, with riverside paths either side if you want to stretch your legs.
